sloka: सिंहनादं च ते चक्रुः प्रहृष्टा वनगोचराः।मारुतिं पूजयाञ्चक्रुर्दृष्ट्वा शूलं तथागतम् ।। ६.६७.६६ ।।
transliteration: siṁhanādaṁ ca te cakruḥ prahṛṣṭā vanagocarāḥ।mārutiṁ pūjayāñcakrurdṛṣṭvā śūlaṁ tathāgatam ।। 6.67.66 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the pike broken by Hanuman, the army of Vanaras rejoiced and roared repeatedly all over and rushed.
